prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity north-star mockup for a mobile-first wedding invitation webpage, portrait phone canvas
Primary request: Design composition option A for a complete luxury digital wedding invitation. This must unmistakably read as an interactive mobile website, not a poster. The page opens as an heirloom invitation case: two tall oxblood lacquer doors with fine botanical embossing meet around a dimensional antique-brass wax seal. Show the opening state transitioning into a pearl vellum invitation below, with the guest name and first content chapter visible. Build an editorial, ceremonial single-column page that includes an invitation cover, personalized greeting, countdown, circular portrait gallery, evening schedule, venue, and RSVP closing, all within one coherent scrolling surface.
Scene/backdrop: full-bleed interface; no device mockup, no hands, no environmental background
Subject: demo wedding invitation for AMARA & JULIAN, 18 OCTOBER 2026, guest ELENA MARLOWE, venue The Glasshouse Garden
Style/medium: exceptionally polished web UI comp, heirloom jewelry-case and trousseau album material language, contemporary luxury with tactile depth
Composition/framing: 9:16 portrait; the first 55% is dominated by the closed/opening lacquer case and brass seal; below it, layered pearl paper panels emerge like drawers from the case, with one striking circular photograph placeholder and a clear RSVP action near the lower fold; restrained navigation only as a tiny progress rail
Lighting/mood: intimate evening light, reflective lacquer edges, softly lit vellum, cinematic but readable
Color palette: deep oxblood and black cherry dominate, pearl blush paper, muted mauve shadows, antique champagne brass; no terracotta
Materials/textures: real-looking lacquer, woven moiré silk, deckled translucent vellum, engraved brass, fine blind-embossed botanicals
Text (verbatim): "AMARA & JULIAN" "DEAR ELENA MARLOWE" "18 OCTOBER 2026" "BREAK THE SEAL" "THE GLASSHOUSE GARDEN" "RSVP"
Constraints: mobile web UI; strong readable hierarchy; one dominant focal moment; preserve space and pacing; interface elements must look implementable in HTML/CSS; no invented commercial claims
Avoid: generic cream wedding template, rustic florals, rose-gold gradients, glassmorphism, floating rounded cards, dashboard layout, device frame, hands, watermark, logo
